title: Hours-of-operation limit on overnight home use
summary: In 2024 the Board of Variances and Appeals ruled on whether an hours limit on a business-zoned property stops overnight stays in a home owners wanted to rebuild after the fire, after motions failed to get a majority. In September 2026, after the Planning Department appealed to circuit court and settled, the board adopted an amended decision on a 242 Luna Road, ʻUlupalakua petition saying residential uses do not have hours of operation.

timeline.text: The board voted unanimously to adopt the amended decision and order.
The added explanation says residential uses do not have "hours of operation."
The lawyer said the change adds an explanation but keeps the board's ruling the same.
The lawyer said the department and the petitioners settled, pending board approval of an amended decision.
The board's lawyer said the Planning Department had appealed the board's decision to circuit court.
The board took up a petition about a vacation rental at 242 Luna Road, ʻUlupalakua.
The owners' attorney agreed to write up the board's decision and order.
The board ruled on whether a limit on operating hours stops people from staying overnight in a home on one business-zoned property.
Motion to deny the petition because it is not within the board's purview: A motion to deny the petition as outside the board's authority did not get a majority.
Motion that condition 8 doesn't apply to overnight residential type use: A motion saying condition 8 does not apply to overnight residential-type use did not pass.
The county's attorney said transient vacation rentals (short-term rentals) are not an allowed use on the property.
The owners asked whether people may stay overnight in the home if no business activity happens during those hours.
The owners' attorney said the owners need to know how condition 8 applies before they rebuild the home lost in the fire.
Two property owners asked for a declaratory ruling (a formal answer on how a law applies) about an hours limit on their property.
